name: Fix: in-place fused chain must not overwrite user-requested intermediate output slots

fix.change: Added requestedOutputSlotSet.count(srcSlot) to mustDisable condition in in-place fusion check
fix.root_cause: Element-wise chain fusion (add+sigmoid) executed in-place on matmul output buffer (slot 0), overwriting intermediate result. The in-place disable logic checked frozenOutputSlots, valueDepInputSlots, and slotConsumerCount but NOT whether the slot was a user-requested output.
fix.diagnosis: DSP diagnostics showed FUSION: applied ELEMENTWISE_CHAIN fusion, slots 1-2 (2 ops) with inPlaceFused=1 and WRITE_SLOT: slot=2 tag=in-place-fused. sigmoid(matmul_result) was ~0.92 confirming in-place overwrote ~2.43 matmul values.

verification.before: testDenseLayerForwardPass fails: expected matmul ~2.43, got sigmoid ~0.92
